title: Panelists claiming trade agreements with other planets

tellings.quote: on a a panel with guys I mean who insisted that we have trade agreements with other planets and stuff and we're we're trading back and forth.

plain: Some people in this world claim that humanity already has trade agreements with other planets and swaps goods back and forth with them. Peter Levenda, a writer presented on the show as a CIA historian, tells Michels he once sat on a conference panel with men who insisted on exactly this.
